name: Arc Pro B70 Qwen3.5-27B token-gen (vLLM, single-req)
methodology: vLLM (Intel upstream), dynamic-FP8 BF16 path, single request; mem-util capped 0.8 for stability (wendell, Level1Techs)
notes: Native FP8 model crashed - needed dynamic-quant BF16. 4x B70 TP=4 50-req: 370 t/s avg / 550 t/s peak output, TTFT ~11.5s; 8-req 2-card 97.8 t/s agg. vs 4x 3090 same test ~348 t/s.
